key_insight: OptGraph turns past optimization attempts into a typed graph and uses graph retrieval to improve LLM-based evolutionary optimization with better pattern reuse, correction, and refinement.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to make automated optimization agents more reliable across tasks without retraining model parameters.
method: Builds a typed graph of reusable experience linking modeling patterns, formalization, implementation, and error fixes.
Retrieves graph neighborhoods at inference time to add structured context for modeling, verification, and iterative improvement.
Updates the graph with execution traces and verification feedback to continuously expand knowledge.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports benchmark experiments showing OptGraph improves average exact accuracy by 8.9% over state-of-the-art prompt-based automated optimization frameworks.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of graph construction and retrieval, and the approach may be harder to implement than standard prompting pipelines.
paper_title: OptGraph: Large Language Models Enhanced Evolutionary Optimization Via Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
